input.free_text_description: The system operates in the user management, microservices infrastructure domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include handler, role user, tx manager consuming. Core business data revolves around ChannelInfo, RoleEntity, UserEntity, UserRole. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to send and receive messages, so that I can communicate with other users in real time.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage handler operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage role user operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage tx manager consuming operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
